item.title: The 'Sadge' Emote Is Six Years Old Today
item.description: Sadge is an emote on Twitch depicting a flattened version of Pepe the Frog with a sad, disappointed expression and a downward glance. The emote is commonly used as a reaction to convey sadness or depression in chats on Twitch, but also appears in memes and a form of copypasta elsewhere online.

item.title: The Top 5 Absolute Wackiest Stories Of 2025
item.description: 2025 was… a lot. From AI hitting mildly terrifying levels to political chaos and peak brainrot, one thing never stopped: the wacky stories. In this video, we count down the Top 5 Wackiest Stories of 2025 that had the internet completely losing it: #5 RaptureTok: TikTokers predicting the world would end on September 23rd…

item.title: 7 Years Ago, The World Record Egg Cracked The Code For Instagram Engagement
item.description: World Record Egg, also known as The Egg Meme and Instagram Egg, is a stock photograph of an egg that became the most-liked post on Instagram in mid-January 2019, overtaking a birth announcement post made by Kylie Jenner.
